name: System path mutation guard
summary: Block explicit file mutation commands targeting protected operating-system paths.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that detects common copy, move, install, permission, metadata, directory, and stream-write commands whose static destination is an operating-system path.
refuses: It does not write, repair, restore, or change permissions on system files.
It does not resolve dynamic shell paths or follow filesystem links.
It does not replace operating-system sandboxing or privilege separation.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize static command destinations under protected operating-system paths.
